messages:
ashley: Quick handoff — I'll be OOO after 22:00 UTC but leaving the weekend oncall in good shape. Planned deploy tonight at 00:30 UTC: swap model from `rwd-xlarge-v1` -> `rwd-xlarge-v1-quant` and change KV cache TTL from 24h -> 6h. No DB migrations, just artifact + serving-config update. Expected risk: cold KV churn -> transient p95 latency spike for ~10–20m and higher token cost during the warmup window.

raj: I'll take rollout-watcher duty 00:20–04:00 UTC. I'll keep tabs on p50/p95, qps, and error rate. If p95 > baseline * 1.25 for >10m or errors increase >1% absolute, I'll call for rollback. Ping me in thread or DM. :raised_back_of_hand:

leah: Quick clarify — does the config change touch any auth or routing rules? Need to know if routing fallbacks are affected.

ashley: @leah no auth/routing changes. We are only updating the model artifact pointer and the quantization flag. Smart routing still points to the same family; fallback to cpu/dedicated tiers unchanged. Canary will run on 2 nodes in ash-1 region first.

sasha: I'll run the smoke checklist during canary: health-check, embeddings sanity, and a set of 10 prompt evals (small/e2e). Smoke commands: ```
# run locally from ops box
./tools/smoke.sh --canary --checks health,embeddings,sampling
```

deploy-bot: Deploy job scheduled: job_id=5678, canary=00:30 UTC, gradual roll to 100% by 01:00 UTC. Logs: https://ci.redwood/deploys/5678 :link:

ashley: Oncall playbook notes: if KV churn causes sustained p95 > 20% above baseline for 15m, trigger immediate rollback (Platform Console -> Rollouts -> Revert). If canary nodes hit OOMs or repeated 5xx, abort full rollout and open incident channel #incidents. If cost spikes but latency ok, consider throttling traffic with rate-limit rule until pre-warm finishes.

raj: I've got a small helper script to prefill KV prefixes if needed — I'll trigger it 10m before canary start. Command: ```
python3 scripts/kv_prefill.py --model rwd-xlarge-v1-quant --keys 5000 --concurrency 8
``` I'll post logs here if I run it.

leah: Noted. Also flagging freeze window question: we have org freeze 23:00–05:00 UTC but product approved a one-off exception for this rollout. Confirmed with @product. So OK to proceed but keep the window minimal.

oncall-bot: handoff recorded by ashley at 1890004321. Reminder checklist: monitor dashboards /dashboards/serving/latency, /dashboards/serving/errors, and /dashboards/cost/token-usage. Watchers: @raj (primary), @sasha (secondary).

sasha: I'll stay reachable for review pings until 02:00 UTC and can jump on a quick call if rollback is needed. Good luck :rocket:

ashley: Thanks team — tagging @raj @sasha @leah :eyes: I'll DM any last-minute notes before I step away. If anything unexpected, escalate to #incidents and notify oncall primary.
